uvm_error.description: UVM_ERROR report, with or without a file location (run_test's own reports have none); the look-ahead skips the summary count line

uvm_fatal.description: UVM_FATAL report, with or without a file location (run_test's own reports have none); the look-ahead skips the summary count line

uvm_summary_count.description: Non-zero UVM_ERROR or UVM_FATAL count in the report summary

uvm_summary_missing.description: The log has no UVM report summary, so UVM never reached its report phase
uvm_summary_missing.msg: no UVM report summary in the log
